test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

It was __inevitable __that the team management would sack him after his rude behaviour.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4, i.e., **"unavoidable".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inevitable: **(अवश्यंभावी) - Certain to happen; unavoidable.

 
 
• **Example**: It was inevitable that the rain would cancel the picnic.
 
 
 
• **Unavoidable**: (अपरिहार्य) - Not able to be avoided; inevitable.
 
 
• **Example**: Due to the snowstorm, the flight delays were unavoidable.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"unavoidable".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Impassionate**: This is likely a mistaken term. The intended might be "**impassioned**" which means (भावुक) - Filled with or showing great emotion.
 
• **Amiable**: (मिलनसार) - Having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner.
 
• **Measurable**: (मापनीय) - Able to be measured; quantifiable.
